CREATE TABLE "public"."Listing" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "attributes" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "baseGuests" int4,
  "checkInSeconds" int4,
  "checkOutSeconds" int4,
  "cleaningFeeCents" int4,
  "contentHtml" text NOT NULL,
  "coverMediaId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "extraGuestFeeCents" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ivaBasisPoints" int4,
  "maxGuests" int4,
  "minStayNights" int4,
  "petFeeCents" int4,
  "petsAllowed" bool,
  "pricePerNightCents" int4,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "tourismBasisPoints" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "wpId" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_active_bookable_29820d57" CHECK (NOT active OR ("pricePerNightCents" IS NOT NULL AND "pricePerNightCents" > 0 AND "maxGuests" IS NOT NULL AND "maxGuests" > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_attributes_descriptive_c63c8437" CHECK (jsonb_typeof(attributes) = 'object' AND NOT (attributes ?| ARRAY['price', 'cleaning_fee', 'extra_guest_fee', 'pet_fee', 'iva', 'tourism_tax', 'pricePerNightCents', 'cleaningFeeCents', 'extraGuestFeeCents', 'petFeeCents', 'ivaBasisPoints', 'tourismBasisPoints'])),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_guests_valid_ecea1ec8" CHECK (("maxGuests" IS NULL OR "maxGuests" > 0) AND ("baseGuests" IS NULL OR ("baseGuests" > 0 AND "maxGuests" IS NOT NULL AND "baseGuests" <= "maxGuests"))),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_min_stay_positive_b5341822" CHECK ("minStayNights" IS NULL OR "minStayNights" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_money_nonnegative_2dcdefbe" CHECK (("pricePerNightCents" IS NULL OR "pricePerNightCents" >= 0) AND ("cleaningFeeCents" IS NULL OR "cleaningFeeCents" >= 0) AND ("extraGuestFeeCents" IS NULL OR "extraGuestFeeCents" >= 0) AND ("petFeeCents" IS NULL OR "petFeeCents" >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_tax_basis_points_range_75fe593b" CHECK (("ivaBasisPoints" IS NULL OR "ivaBasisPoints" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000) AND ("tourismBasisPoints" IS NULL OR "tourismBasisPoints" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_time_seconds_range_6e2bad98" CHECK (("checkInSeconds" IS NULL OR "checkInSeconds" BETWEEN 0 AND 86399) AND ("checkOutSeconds" IS NULL OR "checkOutSeconds" BETWEEN 0 AND 86399)),
  CONSTRAINT "listing_version_positive_efca705d" CHECK ("version" > 0)
)
